todos.title: Get UK passports for both children
todos.notes: ELIGIBILITY: Children are automatically British at birth — Nick is British by birth (otherwise than by descent), married to mother. No registration needed, straight to passport. APPLY ONLINE at passport.service.gov.uk (one per child). NO paper forms, NO embassy involvement. CRITICAL WARNINGS: (1) Internationale Geburtsurkunde NOT accepted post-Brexit — need full German Geburtsurkunde + certified translation. (2) Nick's UK birth cert MUST be LONG FORM showing parents. (3) Family photos of child WITH parents (named+dated, spanning birth to now) are MANDATORY and commonly missed. (4) HMPO holds originals 6-10 weeks — order extra copies if needed for Einbürgerung simultaneously. (5) ~19% of apps get queried for missing docs — be thorough first time. (6) If HMPO requests more docs, you have exactly 6 weeks or app is cancelled and fee lost. FEES: £61.50 + £19.86 DHL per child = £81.36 each. NO fast-track for overseas first applications. TOTAL COST est: ~€420-530 for both kids (incl. translations, courier, photos). PROCESSING: 6-10 weeks typical. Best Sep-Mar (avoid May-Aug peak). COUNTERSIGNATORY: Must hold current passport (UK/Ireland/EU/US/Commonwealth). Must be from recognised profession. Must have known NICK (not child) for 2+ years. Cannot be family, cannot live at same address. Same person can do both kids. They get a digital link from HMPO + write on back of one physical photo per child. DOCUMENTS PER CHILD: Child's full Geburtsurkunde + certified translation, Nick's UK passport (colour copy ALL pages incl blank), Nick's LONG FORM UK birth certificate, wife's German passport (colour copy ALL pages), wife's full birth certificate + certified translation, Heiratsurkunde + certified translation (include even though technically optional post-2006), 3x identity/residency docs (e.g. Aufenthaltstitel + Finanzamt letter + employer letter), 5-10 family photos (named+dated on back), child's German passport (colour copy ALL pages), countersigned physical photo. SEND TO: HM Passport Office, L2-INT-S, Long Croft Road, Corby, NN18 8UA via DHL Express. TRANSLATIONS: Must be by beeidigter Übersetzer (sworn translator). Search 'beeidigter Übersetzer Englisch Hessen'. ~€40-60 per document.

subtasks.title: PHASE 1 — DOCUMENTS
Confirm Nick's UK birth certificate is LONG FORM (shows parents' names) — if short form only, order long form from GRO (gov.uk/order-copy-birth-death-marriage-certificate, £11, 2-3 weeks)
Nick's UK passport — AVAILABLE
Request full Geburtsurkunde (NOT internationale) for Child 1 from Standesamt (~€12-15)
Request full Geburtsurkunde (NOT internationale) for Child 2 from Standesamt (~€12-15)
Get wife's full German birth certificate (Geburtsurkunde) if not already to hand
Get Heiratsurkunde (marriage certificate) — include even though technically optional for post-2006 births
Make colour photocopies of ALL pages (incl blank) of: both kids' German passports, wife's German passport, Nick's UK passport
Gather 3 identity/residency docs: e.g. Aufenthaltstitel + Finanzamt letter + employer/Krankenkasse letter
PHASE 2 — TRANSLATIONS
Find beeidigter Übersetzer (sworn translator) for English in Hessen — search Landgericht Frankfurt database
Commission certified translation: Child 1 Geburtsurkunde (~€40-60)
Commission certified translation: Child 2 Geburtsurkunde (~€40-60)
Commission certified translation: Heiratsurkunde (~€40-60)
Commission certified translation: Wife's birth certificate (~€40-60)
PHASE 3 — PHOTOS
Take UK-spec passport photos for Child 1 (35x45mm, plain light background, digital JPEG min 600x750px). Under-6 relaxed rules: no neutral expression required
Take UK-spec passport photos for Child 2 (same specs)
Print 5-10 family photos per child showing child WITH parents, spanning birth to present. Write names + date on back of each
PHASE 4 — COUNTERSIGNATORY
Countersignatory — IDENTIFIED
Brief countersignatory: they will receive digital email link from HMPO to confirm identity. Must respond promptly.
Get countersignatory to write on back of 1 physical photo per child: 'I certify that this is a true likeness of [child name]' + signature + date
If countersignatory holds non-UK/Irish passport: prepare colour copy of their passport photo page to include
PHASE 5 — APPLY ONLINE
Apply online at passport.service.gov.uk for Child 1 — upload digital photo, pay £61.50 + £19.86 DHL
Apply online at passport.service.gov.uk for Child 2 — upload digital photo, pay £61.50 + £19.86 DHL
Note both application reference numbers
Notify countersignatory that HMPO digital confirmation link(s) are incoming
PHASE 6 — SEND DOCUMENTS
Photograph every document for personal records before sending
Create cover sheet listing all documents + both reference numbers
Send all originals via DHL Express to: HM Passport Office, L2-INT-S, Long Croft Road, Corby, NN18 8UA (~€30-50)
Keep DHL tracking number
PHASE 7 — WAIT & MONITOR
Confirm DHL delivery to HMPO
Monitor email for HMPO correspondence — if they request more docs, respond IMMEDIATELY (6-week deadline or app cancelled + fee lost)
Receive passports by DHL to German address
Receive original documents back separately by DHL
Verify passport details are correct on receipt

todos.title: Start German citizenship application
todos.notes: Address: Schießgartenstraße 3, Götzenhain (Stadtteil of Dreieich). CORRECTED: Stadt Dreieich handles Einbürgerung directly (43,600+ residents, above 7,500 threshold). NOT Kreis Offenbach. Application goes to Stadt Dreieich → forwarded to Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt for decision. Contact: Stadt Dreieich, Hauptstraße 45, 63303 Dreieich. Email: stadt@dreieich.de. Tel: 06103 601-0. Married to German citizen. 10+ years residency (far exceeds 3-year minimum for spouses). B1 certificate and naturalization test already completed. Fee: €255 adult (collected by RP Darmstadt). Timeline: 18-24 months processing.

todos.title: Check Ford Kuga PHEV charging cable compatibility with German public stations
todos.notes: Ford Kuga 2021 full hybrid / PHEV. Check whether the included charging cable (likely Type 2 / Mennekes) works at standard German public charging points. Kuga PHEV onboard charger maxes at 3.7kW. Type 2 is the EU standard so it SHOULD be compatible, but verify the specific cable that came with the car (Mode 2 domestic vs Mode 3 public). If it's only a Mode 2 granny cable, you may need a separate Type 2-to-Type 2 Mode 3 cable for public stations (~€150-300).
